Questions.content: What is the criteria for considering a penguin "more than 5 years old"? Is it strictly greater than 5, or does it include 6-year-old penguins as well?

Answers.content: The criteria for considering a penguin "more than 5 years old" should be strictly greater than 5 years. Therefore, a 6-year-old penguin would not be considered "more than 5 years old." Based on this, we need to filter out any penguins that are exactly 5 years old or older when answering the question.
